# Fade in from black and out to black

- Kind: `recipe`
- Category: `studio`
- Slug: `studio/fade-from-black`

## Summary

Darkroom recipe (basic). An opacity keyframe from 0 to 1 over 1 s at the start and back to 0 at the end is a clean fade; on the bottom video track black shows through.

## Details

### When to use
The start and end of a video.
### What a pro does and why
An opacity keyframe from 0 to 1 over 1 s at the start and back to 0 at the end is a clean fade; on the bottom video track black shows through.
### Ops
```json
{
  "summary": "Fade in from black",
  "ops": [
    {"op": "set_keyframes", "clipId": "CLIP_ID", "property": "opacity", "keyframes": [{"t": 0, "value": 0, "ease": "easeOut"}, {"t": 1, "value": 1, "ease": "linear"}]}
  ]
}
```
### How to adjust
Slower: 2 s. End of video: same op on the last clip with 1 then 0 at its end.
